verdict.rationale: Docs show a default 5-minute timeout that can be extended via `sandbox.extendTimeout()`, and persistent sandboxes can auto-save state and resume later, which supports long-running agent workflows across sessions rather than a single continuous multi-day run. There's no documented maximum timeout or evidence of truly continuous multi-day execution in one session. missing for 10: explicit max timeout/duration limits, evidence of continuous multi-day (not resumed) sessions, independent confirmation of long-running stability.
